# Developer function index

This index covers package-owned R and Rust definitions. Internal functions do not
form a stable user API. Scientific algorithms will receive explanations and
numerical demonstrations in the relevant chapters; validation, formatting, and
storage helpers remain in the reference index.

R-to-Rust wrappers and their compiled kernels are listed separately because they
are distinct definitions of the same interface. Local R helpers are scoped to
their enclosing functions. Rust test definitions are separate from production
code. Anonymous callbacks, vendored dependencies, development scripts, and
historical sources in `context/` are outside this index.

Use the browser's find command or book search to locate a function. A
[standalone searchable inventory](downloads/function-inventory.html) provides
category filters. Its [JSON data](downloads/function-inventory.json) are also
available for programmatic use.
